test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

One of the apples that you have picked up are rotten.
solution: The correct answer is **'are rotten'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'is rotten'** should be used instead of **'are rotten'.** • The noun following the phrase "one of the" is always followed by a plural noun and **singular helping verb.** • *Example: Tickle is one of the broadest and deepest subjects in science.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *One of the apples that you have picked up** is rotten.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'are rotten'** के स्थान पर **'is rotten'** का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • वाक्यांश "one of the" के बाद आने वाली noun के बाद हमेशा plural noun और singular helping verb होती है। • ​*Example: Tickle is one of the broadest and deepest subjects in science.* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है। 31:T569, The correct answer is **'Do something secretly'.**
